_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in Anxiety; coil base rate and analyst’s F&G/30d range anchors favor a one-rung drift to Complacency only if the range holds, not a breaker.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative has no forward phase call (split on framing, not on direction)
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~42-54, BTC 30d inside ~-8% to +3%, funding near flat, no ETF-flow reversal
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G <35 with funding negative and ETF flows ~0 (down), or ETF flows rebound hard with F&G >60 (up)
